about: A live run of T4-habit-tracker, recorded for replay.

features.name: Daily habit tracking
features.request: Help me track three habits every day: walk, read, drink water.

value.name: Daily Habits
value.summary: Track walk, read and drink water each day. Mark a habit done today and see how many days in a row you've kept it up. You can add more habits.

code.html:

code.css: .wrap{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;padding:var(--ui-padding)}h1{font-size:var(--ui-size-title);margin:0 0 var(--ui-space-1)}.sub{margin:0 0 var(--ui-space-3);color:var(--ui-text-secondary);font-size:var(--ui-size-secondary)}.list{list-style:none;margin:0 0 var(--ui-space-5);padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--ui-space-2)}.list li{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:var(--ui-space-3);background:var(--ui-surface);border:1px solid var(--ui-divider);border-radius:var(--ui-radius-panel);padding:var(--ui-space-3) var(--ui-space-4)}.hname{flex:1 1 140px;font-weight:600}.streak{flex:0 1 auto;color:var(--ui-text-secondary);font-size:var(--ui-size-secondary)}.streak .n{color:var(--ui-text);font-size:var(--ui-size-section);font-weight:600}button{min-height:var(--ui-target);padding:0 var(--ui-space-4);border-radius:var(--ui-radius-control);border:1px solid var(--ui-accent);background:var(--ui-accent);color:#fff;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}button.done{background:var(--ui-accent-soft);color:var(--ui-text)}button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ui-text);outline-offset:2px}label{display:block;margin-bottom:var(--ui-space-1);font-size:var(--ui-size-secondary)}.row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--ui-space-2)}input{flex:1 1 180px;min-height:var(--ui-target);padding:0 var(--ui-space-3);border:1px solid var(--ui-control-border);border-radius:var(--ui-radius-control);font:inherit;background:var(--ui-surface);color:var(--ui-text)}#msg{min-height:1.5em;margin:0 0 var(--ui-space-2);color:var(--ui-error);font-size:var(--ui-size-secondary)}
